output_list.criticism: The function distr() has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalDistributed variable is increased by the value of _value, which can be a large number. If the totalSupply is not large enough, the totalDistributed variable can overflow and become a large number. This can cause the function to return true even if the totalDistributed variable has not reached the totalSupply, which can lead to a security issue.

The function getTokens() has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function first checks if the value is greater than the totalRemaining variable. If it is, it sets the value to the totalRemaining variable. Then, it checks if the value is less than or equal to the totalRemaining variable. If it is, it distributes the tokens. If the totalDistributed variable is greater than or equal to the totalSupply variable, it sets the distributionFinished variable to true. The function then sets the value to a new value based on the totalRemaining variable and the 100000 and 99999 constants. This can lead to a security issue if the value is greater than the totalRemaining variable.

The function distr() has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalDistributed variable is increased by the value of _amount, which can be a large number. If the totalSupply is not large enough, the totalDistributed variable can overflow and become a large number. This can cause the function to return true even if the totalDistributed variable has not reached the totalSupply, which can lead to a security issue.
